Transaction Security Policy: Monitor Critical Permission Changes
TransactionSecurityPolicy.description: Monitor changes to critical Salesforce permissions, including permission set assignments, removals, and sensitive privilege changes. This policy is intended to detect potential privilege escalation and notify the Salesforce/Security team for review.
